notablePrerequisites: Karn has at least three loyalty counters.
description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, adding {C}{C}.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Karn's second ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, putting Ugin's Nexus into your hand from exile.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Karn.
Repeat.
